scenarios.title: Background Task
scenarios.primaryAction: Register registers a SystemTrigger(TimeZoneChange) background task; Status -> 'Registered', Unregister becomes enabled.

scenarios.title: Background Task with Condition
scenarios.primaryAction: Register registers a background task with an InternetAvailable condition; Status -> 'Registered'.

scenarios.title: Servicing Complete Task
scenarios.primaryAction: Register registers a ServicingComplete trigger task; Status -> 'Registered'.

scenarios.title: Background Task with Time Trigger
scenarios.primaryAction: Register requests background access then registers a 15-min TimeTrigger; Status -> 'Registered'.

scenarios.title: Background Task with Application Trigger
scenarios.primaryAction: Register requests access and registers an ApplicationTrigger; Signal fires the trigger; Status/Result update.

scenarios.title: Grouped Background Task
scenarios.primaryAction: Register registers a task inside a BackgroundTaskRegistrationGroup; Status -> 'Registered'.

gradingRule: Each scenario: structural (controls present, non-blank, nav reachable) AND behavioral (Register produces the documented Status change). A present-but-dead Register control caps the scenario at 'partial'.
